content.short: Stablecoin payments and mobile-money off-ramps in Africa.
content.description: ElementPay is a B2B stablecoin payments platform building cross-border rails for Africa. It offers USDC invoicing, crypto-to-mobile-money APIs, and compliant off-ramps that let businesses settle payments between stablecoins and local currencies across corridors such as Kenya, Nigeria, and Ghana. Using USDC over networks including Ethereum and Base, ElementPay connects on-chain value to Africa's mobile-money and banking systems, so companies can pay suppliers, staff, and partners quickly and cheaply without relying on slow correspondent banking. Positioned as agentic, API-first payment infrastructure, it targets fintechs, exporters, and enterprises that need reliable stablecoin settlement and local disbursement across emerging African markets.
